title: Qualify scalar callback result inference and C-seed canonical native lowering
description:
I retain two checked source-route boundaries observed in ordinary scalar arithmetic callback acceptance for parent500906. Frozen fixture /tmp/nano-arithmetic-source-589e1_iu/callbacks.nano passes interpreter and C-seed native legacy execution. Selfhost Stage1/Stage2 refuse float_to_bits directly applied to reduce(values,0.0,combine) because reduce's inferred result is not FLOAT, although combine is declared fn(float,float)->float. C-seed canonical emission verifies and executes in VM but nvm2c refuses FUNCREF at function2 offset38; direct scalar callback native specialization/closure transport is not supplied by this producer path. I preserve /tmp/nanolang-arithmetic-source-gcc-corrected.log and do not count these as paired success. I need precise return inference and a separately reviewed native callable contract or producer specialization before full cross-producer callback acceptance. Exact direct arithmetic and optimized interpreter map/reduce helpers are independently tested; no historical failing compiler artifact replay.

Final typed-local callback gate adds a third concrete legacy boundary: selfhost generated nl_reduce takes int64_t initial and int64_t(*)(int64_t,int64_t), but the source float callback is emitted as double(*)(double,double). At fresh reviewed sourcefe1d376b, ordinary shadows assert in dyn_array_get_int rather than publish native output. I retain /tmp/nanolang-arithmetic-source-final-gcc.log (5 methods,65.319s, two legacy failures) and generated paths /tmp/nano_native_1789739762_0 and /tmp/nano_native_1789739768_0 where present. I will not replay these failed artifacts or the legacy route until a separately reviewed defensive repair. The same typed source passes interpreter, C-seed legacy, and selfhost canonical VM/native; C-seed canonical native remains explicit FUNCREF refusal. These supported routes can be qualified in separately named tests, not counted as full callback acceptance.
